items.title: Blake Corum: Visits end zone again in Week 6
items.text:
Corum produced 42 yards on nine carries and reeled in both of his targets for 18 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 18-16 loss against the Cardinals.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Huge day despite QB turmoil
items.text:
Nabers caught 12 of 15 targets for 165 yards in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints.

items.title: Quentin Johnston: Just short of TD on 57-yard catch
items.text:
Johnston caught one of three targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: No touchdowns in Week 6
items.text:
Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, no touchdowns and one interception and rushed five times for 16 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win versus the Chargers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Fails to produce TD in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Herbert completed 22 of 37 passes for 204 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs. He also rushed five times for 26 yards.
